The '''Sarkania system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the substance known as [[Sarkanian jelly]].<ref name="GoF">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Nightmare Machine]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Sarkanian jelly]]|system=Sarkania [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sarkania system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square M-14.<ref name="TEA" />
